name: spotlight-card4

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the complete card clean, with the skyline, heading and full body line and no cursor.

tagline: A skyline photo card with a heading and a quiet pointer glow.
summary: A single dark card pairing a city-at-dusk photo with a heading and a line about supported technologies. A faint spotlight follows the pointer near it.
appearance: One dark rounded card floating on black, with a wide dusk cityscape photo near the top, a white centred heading and three grey centred lines of small body text beneath.
behaviour: A soft proximity spotlight brightens a patch of the card as the pointer approaches, though in the clip the card looks almost still. Nothing is clickable.
demo_content: Heading "Seamless Animation For All" over a dusk skyline, naming React, Next.js and Tailwind
search_phrases: card with a photo and pointer glow
dark card that lights near the cursor
single card with image and caption
spotlight card for a feature list
card that reacts as the mouse nears
rounded tile with photo on top
image and text card with soft light
use_when: One feature needs a visual card that still feels alive as the pointer passes.
avoid_when: The photo is a local webp and the card width is fixed, so both need edits to reuse.
customise: The image, heading and copy are written into the card; only the spotlight wrapper's mode and width can change.
weight_why: One card and one gradient; no loop or canvas.

a11y.note: The photo's alt text is just "grid", so it does not describe the skyline.

issues: The spotlight barely registers in the clip, so the effect is hard to judge.
The image alt text is the generic word "grid".
polish_why: Solid dark card with a strong photo; the glow is nearly invisible and the copy is tiny.
title: Proximity Spotlight Card
